$comment: /problems/ — the problem situations each cycle works on, from content/problems (none public yet; they're published each cycle, owners named only with consent), and the door for bringing one: the account, with path=problem.

meta.need: As someone with a problem worth solving, or deciding whether the work is real, I need to see what The Labs works on and how to bring a problem, so that I can bring one or join one.

title: Problems
description: The real problems Build Cycle teams work on, and how to bring one.

hero.title: Real problems, worth twelve weeks.
hero.lede: A Build Cycle doesn't start with a brief. It starts with a problem situation: something real and messy that people face, brought by the people who face it. Teams form round it, and what they make goes back to whoever brought it.

empty.before: The {title} cycle's problems are published after its Showcase on {showcase}.
empty.after: Problem situations appear here as each cycle publishes them, with their owners named only when they've agreed.

bring.title: Have one?
bring.body: Agencies, libraries, employers and neighbours bring them. If it's real, affects people, and could use twelve weeks of a team's attention, tell us about it. Make your free account and say what it is; someone from the Lab near you will follow up.
bring.note: You decide whether your organization is named on the page.

problem.$comment: Words for a problem's own page.
problem.none: No project has come of it yet.

join.title: Work on one.
join.lede: Make your free account, then apply for the next Build Cycle from there.
